subject: Statistics
question_text: If P(A) = 0.30, P(B) = 0.50 and P(A and B) = 0.10, what is P(A or B)?
explanation_detailed: For any two events, P(A or B) = P(A) + P(B) minus P(A and B). Here 0.30 + 0.50 - 0.10 = 0.70.

subject: Statistics
question_text: If the probability of event A is 0.65, what is the probability of the complement of A?
explanation_detailed: The complement rule states that P(A complement) = 1 minus P(A). So 1 - 0.65 = 0.35.

subject: Statistics
question_text: What is the expected value of a single fair six-sided die?
explanation_detailed: Expected value is the average of all outcomes weighted equally. (1 + 2 + 3 + 4 + 5 + 6) divided by 6 equals 3.5.

subject: Statistics
question_text: For a binomial distribution with n = 5 and p = 0.4, what is P(X = 2)?
explanation_detailed: Use the binomial formula with C(5,2) = 10. P(X = 2) = 10 times (0.4)^2 times (0.6)^3 = 0.3456.

subject: Statistics
question_text: In a Poisson distribution with mean lambda = 3, what is P(X = 0)?
explanation_detailed: For Poisson, P(X = 0) = e raised to the power of minus lambda. e^(-3) is about 0.0498.

subject: Statistics
question_text: What is the variance of a binomial random variable with n = 10 and p = 0.3?
explanation_detailed: For a binomial distribution, variance equals n times p times q, where q = 1 minus p. So 10 times 0.3 times 0.7 = 2.1.

subject: Statistics
question_text: If P(A and B) = 0.12 and P(B) = 0.40, what is the conditional probability P(A given B)?
explanation_detailed: Conditional probability is P(A and B) divided by P(B). Here 0.12 divided by 0.40 equals 0.30.

subject: Statistics
question_text: How many equally likely outcomes are in the sample space when two fair coins are tossed once?
explanation_detailed: Each coin has two outcomes, so the sample space is HH, HT, TH and TT. That gives four equally likely outcomes.

subject: Statistics
question_text: Which statement is true for a normal distribution?
option_a: It is always skewed to the right
option_b: Its mean, median and mode are equal
option_d: Its range is always from 0 to 1
explanation_detailed: A normal curve is symmetric about its center. At that center, the mean, median and mode all coincide.

subject: Statistics
question_text: A value x = 85 comes from a normal distribution with mean 70 and standard deviation 10. What is its z-score?
explanation_detailed: The z-score formula is (x minus mean) divided by standard deviation. (85 - 70) divided by 10 equals 1.50.
